name: coc.nvim
description_en: Nodejs extension host for vim & neovim, load extensions like VSCode and host language servers.
readme_excerpt: Make your Vim/Neovim as smart as VS Code Visit cocnvim.com coc.nvim is an IntelliSense engine for Vim and Neovim. It brings VS Code-like completion, diagnostics, navigation, refactoring, and extension support to both editors through a Node.js service. Quick start See Install coc.nvim for installation instructions and example Vim and Neovim configurations.
